mn22:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn22:2.1: tena kho pana samayena ariṭṭhassa nāma bhikkhuno gaddhabādhipubbassa evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ hoti:
mn22:2.2: tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi - yathā yeme antarāyikā dhammā vuttā bhagavatā, te paṭisevato nālaṃ antarāyāyāti.
mn22:2.4: ariṭṭhassa kira nāma bhikkhuno gaddhabādhipubbassa evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ:
mn22:2.5: tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi - yathā yeme antarāyikā dhammā antarāyikā vuttā bhagavatā, te paṭisevato nālaṃ antarāyāyāti.
mn22:3.1: atha kho te bhikkhū yena ariṭṭho bhikkhu gaddhabādhipubbo tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā ariṭṭhaṃ bhikkhuṃ gaddhabādhipubbaṃ etadavocuṃ:
mn22:3.2: saccaṃ kira te āvuso ariṭṭha evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ:
mn22:3.3: tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā yeme antarāyikā dhammā antarāyikā vuttā bhagavatā, te paṭisevato nālaṃ antarāyāyāti?
mn22:3.4: “evaṃ vyā kho ahaṃ āvuso bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi - yathā yeme antarāyikā dhammā antarāyikā vuttā bhagavatā, te paṭisevato nālaṃ antarāyāyā”ti.
mn22:3.5: atha kho te bhikkhū ariṭṭhaṃ bhikkhuṃ gaddhabādhipubbaṃ etasmā pāpakā diṭṭhigatā vivecetukāmā samanuyuñjanti samanugāhanti samanubhāsanti:
mn22:3.6: “mā hevaṃ āvuso ariṭṭha avaca, mā hevaṃ āvuso ariṭṭha avaca. mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi. na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ. na hi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya.
mn22:3.7: anekapariyāyenahāvuso ariṭṭha antarāyikā dhammā antarāyikā vuttā bhagavatā. alañca pana te paṭisevato antarāyāya.
mn22:3.8: appassādā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahūpāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo.
mn22:3.18: sappasirūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahūpāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo”ti.
mn22:3.19: evampi kho ariṭṭho bhikkhu gaddhabādhipubbo tehi bhikkhūhi samanuyuñjiyamāno samanugāhiyamāno samanubhāsiyamāno tameva pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ thāmasā parāmassa voharati:
mn22:3.20: “evaṃ vyā kho ahaṃ āvuso bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi, yathā yeme antarāyikā dhammā antarāyikā vuttā bhagavatā te paṭisevato nālaṃ antarāyāyā”ti.
mn22:3.21: yato kho te bhikkhū nāsakkhiṃsu ariṭṭhaṃ bhikkhuṃ gaddhabādhipubbaṃ etasmā pāpakā diṭṭhigatā vivecetuṃ, atha te bhikkhū yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
mn22:3.22: “ariṭṭhassa nāma bhante bhikkhuno gaddhabādhipubbassa evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ:
mn22:3.23: tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi, yathā yeme antarāyikā dhammā antarāyikā vuttā bhagavatā te paṭisevato nālaṃ antarāyāyāti.
mn22:3.25: ariṭṭhassa kira nāma bhikkhuno gaddhabādhipubbassa evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ:
mn22:3.26: tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi, yathā yeme antarāyikā dhammā antarāyikā vuttā bhagavatā, te paṭisevato nālaṃ antarāyāyā”ti.
mn22:3.27: atha kho mayaṃ bhante yena ariṭṭho bhikkhu gaddhabādhipubbo tenupasaṅkamimha. upasaṅkamitvā ariṭṭhaṃ bhikkhuṃ gaddhabādhipubbaṃ etadavocumha:
mn22:3.28: saccaṃ kira te āvuso ariṭṭha evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ:
mn22:3.29: tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā yeme antarāyikā dhammā antarāyikā vuttā bhagavatā, te paṭisevato nālaṃ antarāyāyāti?
mn22:3.30: evaṃ vutte bhante ariṭṭho bhikkhu gaddhabādhipubbo amhe etadavoca:
mn22:3.31: evaṃ vyā kho ahaṃ āvuso bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi, yathā yeme antarāyikā dhammā antarāyikā vuttā bhagavatā, te paṭisevato nālaṃ antarāyāyāti.
mn22:3.32: atha kho mayaṃ bhante ariṭṭhaṃ bhikkhuṃ gaddhabādhipubbaṃ etasmā pāpakā diṭṭhigatā vivecetukāmā samanuyuñjimha samanugāhimha samanubhāsimha:
mn22:3.33: “mā hevaṃ āvuso ariṭṭha avaca, mā hevaṃ āvuso ariṭṭha avaca, mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi. na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ. na hi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya.
mn22:3.34: anekapariyāyena hāvuso ariṭṭha antarāyikā dhammā antarāyikā vuttā bhagavatā. alañca pana te paṭisevato antarāyāya.
mn22:3.35: appassādā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahūpāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo.
mn22:3.37: sappasirūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahūpāyāsā ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo”ti.
mn22:3.38: evampi kho bhante ariṭṭho bhikkhu gaddhabādhipubbo amhehi samanuyuñjiyamāno samanugāhiyamāno samanubhāsiyamāno tadeva pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ thāmasā parāmassa abhinivissa voharati:
mn22:3.39: evaṃ vyā kho ahaṃ āvuso bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi, yathā yeme antarāyikā dhammā antarāyikā vuttā bhagavatā, te paṭisevato nālaṃ antarāyāyāti.
mn22:4.1: yato kho mayaṃ bhante nāsakkhimha ariṭṭhaṃ bhikkhuṃ gaddhabādhipubbaṃ etasmā pāpakā diṭṭhigatā vivecetuṃ. atha mayaṃ etamatthaṃ bhagavato ārocemāti.
mn22:5.1: atha kho bhagavā aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantesi:
mn22:5.2: ehi tvaṃ bhikkhu, mama vacanena ariṭṭhaṃ bhikkhuṃ gaddhabādhipubbaṃ āmantehi
mn22:5.4: ‘evaṃ bhante’ti kho so bhikkhu bhagavato paṭissutvā yena ariṭṭho bhikkhu gaddhabādhipubbo tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā ariṭṭhaṃ bhikkhuṃ gaddhabādhipubbaṃ etadavoca:
mn22:5.6: ‘evamāvuso’ti kho ariṭṭho bhikkhu gaddhabādhipubbo tassa bhikkhuno paṭissutvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho ariṭṭhaṃ bhikkhuṃ gaddhabādhipubbaṃ bhagavā etadavoca:
mn22:5.7: saccaṃ kira te ariṭṭha evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ -
mn22:5.8: tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi, yathā yeme antarāyikā dhammā antarāyikā vuttā bhagavatā, te paṭisevato nālaṃ antarāyāyā’ti?
mn22:5.9: “evaṃ vyā kho ahaṃ bhante bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi, yathā yeme antarāyikā dhammā antarāyikā vuttā bhagavatā, te paṭisevato nālaṃ antarāyāyā”ti.
mn22:6.1: kassa kho nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa, mayā evaṃ dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāsi?
mn22:6.2: nanu mayā moghapurisa, anekapariyāyena antarāyikā dhammā antarāyikā vuttā. alañca pana te paṭisevato antarāyāya?
mn22:6.3: appassādā kāmā vuttā mayā bahudukkhā bahūpāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo
mn22:6.13: sappasirūpamā kāmā vuttā mayā, bahudukkhā bahūpāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo.
mn22:6.14: atha ca pana tvaṃ moghapurisa, attanā duggahitena amhe ceva abbhācikkhasi. attānañca khaṇasi. bahuñca apuññaṃ pasavasi.
mn22:6.15: taṃ hi te moghapurisa, bhavissati dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyāti.
mn22:7.3: api nāyaṃ ariṭṭho bhikkhu gaddhabādhipubbo usmīkatopi imasmiṃ dhammavinayeti?
mn22:7.6: evaṃ vutte ariṭṭho bhikkhu gaddhabādhipubbo tuṇhībhūto maṅkubhūto pattakkhandho adhomukho pajjhāyanto appaṭibhāno nisīdi.
mn22:7.7: atha kho bhagavā ariṭṭhaṃ bhikkhuṃ gaddhabādhipubbaṃ tuṇhībhūtaṃ maṅkubhūtaṃ pattakkhandhaṃ adhomukhaṃ pajjhāyantaṃ appaṭibhānaṃ viditvā ariṭṭhaṃ bhikkhuṃ gaddhabādhipubbaṃ etadavoca:
mn22:7.8: ‘paññāyissasi kho tvaṃ moghapurisa etena sakena pāpakena diṭṭhigatena.
mn22:8.2: tumhepi me bhikkhave evaṃ dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānātha, yathāyaṃ ariṭṭho bhikkhu gaddhabādhipubbo attanā duggahītena amhe ceva abbhācikkhati. attānañca khanati, bahuñca apuññaṃ pasavatīti?
mn22:8.4: anekapariyāyena hi no bhante, antarāyikā dhammā antarāyikā vuttā bhagavatā.
mn22:8.6: appassādā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahūpāyāsā ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo.
mn22:8.8: sappasirūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahūpāyāsā ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo’ti.
mn22:8.9: sādhu bhikkhave, sādhu kho me tumhe bhikkhave evaṃ dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānātha.
mn22:8.10: anekapariyāyena hi vo bhikkhave antarāyikā dhammā antarāyikā vuttā mayā. alaṃ ca pana te paṭisevato antarāyāya.
mn22:8.11: appassādā kāmā vuttā mayā bahudukkhā bahūpāyāsā ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo,
mn22:8.13: sappasirūpamā kāmā vuttā mayā bahudukkhā bahūpāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo.
mn22:8.14: atha ca panāyaṃ ariṭṭho bhikkhu gaddhabādhipubbo attanā duggahītena amhe ceva abbhācikkhati. attānañca khanati. bahuñca apuññaṃ pasavati.
mn22:8.15: taṃ hi tassa moghapurisassa bhavissati dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya.
mn22:9.1: so vata bhikkhave aññatreva kāmehi aññatra kāmasaññāya aññatra kāmavitakkehi kāme paṭisevissatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
mn22:10.1: idha bhikkhave ekacce moghapurisā dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇanti:
mn22:10.2: suttaṃ, geyyaṃ, veyyākaraṇaṃ, gāthaṃ, udānaṃ, itivuttakaṃ, jātakaṃ, abbhutadhammaṃ, vedallaṃ.
mn22:10.3: te taṃ dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇitvā tesaṃ dhammānaṃ paññāya atthaṃ na upaparikkhanti.
mn22:10.4: tesaṃ te dhammā paññāya atthaṃ anupaparikkhataṃ na nijjhānaṃ khamanti.
mn22:10.5: te upārambhānisaṃsā ceva dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇanti itivādappamokkhānisaṃsā ca.
mn22:10.6: yassa catthāya dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇanti tañcassa atthaṃ nānubhonti.
mn22:10.7: tesaṃ te dhammā duggahītā dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya saṃvattanti.
mn22:10.10: seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso alagaddatthiko alagaddagavesī alagaddapariyesanaṃ caramāno -
mn22:10.12: tamenaṃ bhoge vā naṅguṭṭhe vā gaṇheyya.
mn22:10.13: tassa so alagaddo paṭiparivattitvā hatthe vā bāhāya vā aññatarasmiṃ vā aṅgapaccaṅge ḍaseyya,
mn22:10.14: so tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigaccheyya maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ.
mn22:10.17: evameva kho bhikkhave idhekacce moghapurisā dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇanti:
mn22:10.18: suttaṃ, geyyaṃ, veyyākaraṇaṃ, gāthaṃ, udānaṃ, itivuttakaṃ, jātakaṃ, abbhutadhammaṃ, vedallaṃ.
mn22:10.19: te taṃ dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇitvā tesaṃ dhammānaṃ paññāya atthaṃ na upaparikkhanti.
mn22:10.20: tesaṃ te dhammā paññāya atthaṃ anupaparikkhataṃ na nijjhānaṃ khamanti.
mn22:10.21: te upārambhānisaṃsā ceva dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇanti itivādappamokkhānisaṃsā ca.
mn22:10.22: yassa catthāya dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇanti tañcassa atthaṃ nānubhonti.
mn22:10.23: tesaṃ te dhammā duggahītā dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya saṃvattanti.
mn22:11.1: idha pana bhikkhave ekacce kulaputtā dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇanti:
mn22:11.2: suttaṃ, geyyaṃ, veyyākaraṇaṃ, gāthaṃ, udānaṃ, itivuttakaṃ, jātakaṃ, abbhutadhammaṃ, vedallaṃ.
mn22:11.3: te taṃ dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇitvā tesaṃ dhammānaṃ paññāya atthaṃ upaparikkhanti.
mn22:11.4: tesaṃ te dhammā paññāya atthaṃ upaparikkhataṃ nijjhānaṃ khamanti.
mn22:11.5: te na ceva upārambhānisaṃsā dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇanti na itivādappamokkhānisaṃsā ca.
mn22:11.6: yassa catthāya dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇanti tañcassa atthaṃ anubhonti.
mn22:11.7: tesaṃ te dhammā suggahītā dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya saṃvattanti.
mn22:11.10: seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso alagaddatthiko alagaddagavesī alagaddapariyesanaṃ caramāno -
mn22:11.13: ajapadena daṇḍena suniggahitaṃ niggahetvā gīvāya yuggahītaṃ gaṇheyya;
mn22:11.14: kiñcāpi so bhikkhave alagaddo tassa purisassa hatthaṃ vā bāhaṃ vā aññataraṃ vā aṅgapaccaṅgaṃ bhogehi paliveṭheyya, atha kho so neva tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigaccheyya maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ.
mn22:11.17: evameva kho bhikkhave idhekacce kulaputtā dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇanti,
mn22:11.18: suttaṃ, geyyaṃ, veyyākaraṇaṃ, gāthaṃ, udānaṃ, itivuttakaṃ, jātakaṃ, abbhutadhammaṃ, vedallaṃ.
mn22:11.19: te taṃ dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇitvā tesaṃ dhammānaṃ paññāya atthaṃ upaparikkhanti.
mn22:11.20: tesaṃ te dhammā paññāya atthaṃ upaparikkhataṃ nijjhānaṃ khamanti.
mn22:11.21: te na ceva upārambhānisaṃsā dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇanti na itivādappamokkhānisaṃsā ca.
mn22:11.22: yassa catthāya dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇanti tañcassa atthaṃ anubhonti.
mn22:11.23: tesaṃ te dhammā suggahītā dīgharattaṃ atthāya hitāya sukhāya saṃvattanti.
mn22:12.1: tasmātiha bhikkhave yassa me bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājāneyyātha tathā naṃ dhāreyyātha.
mn22:12.2: yassa ca pana me bhāsitassa atthaṃ na ājāneyyātha ahaṃ vā paṭipucchitabbo ye vā panāssu viyattā bhikkhū.
mn22:13.1: kullūpamaṃ vo bhikkhave dhammaṃ desissāmi nittharaṇatthāya no gahaṇatthāya.
mn22:13.3: evambhanteti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
mn22:13.6: so passeyya mahantaṃ udakaṇṇavaṃ, orimaṃ tīraṃ sāsaṅkaṃ sappaṭibhayaṃ, pārimaṃ tīraṃ khemaṃ appaṭibhayaṃ,
mn22:13.7: na cassa nāvā santāraṇī uttarasetu vā apārāpāraṃ gamanāya;
mn22:13.9: “ayaṃ kho mahā udakaṇṇavo orimaṃ tīraṃ sāsaṅkaṃ sappaṭibhayaṃ. pārimaṃ tīraṃ khemaṃ appaṭibhayaṃ.
mn22:13.10: natthi ca nāvā santāraṇī uttarasetu vā apārāpāraṃ gamanāya.
mn22:13.11: yannūnāhaṃ tiṇakaṭṭhasākhāpalāsaṃ saṃkaḍḍhitvā kullaṃ bandhitvā taṃ kullaṃ nissāya hatthehi ca pādehi ca vāyamamāno sotthinā pāraṃ uttareyyanti.”
mn22:13.12: atha kho so bhikkhave puriso tiṇakaṭṭhasākhāpalāsaṃ saṃkaḍḍhitvā kullaṃ bandhitvā taṃ kullaṃ nissāya hatthehi ca pādehi ca vāyamamāno sotthinā pāraṃ uttareyya.
mn22:13.13: tassa purisassa uttiṇṇassa pāraṃ gatassa evamassa:
mn22:13.15: imāhaṃ kullaṃ nissāya hatthehi ca pādehi ca vāyamamāno sotthinā pāraṃ uttiṇṇo.
mn22:13.16: yannūnāhaṃ imaṃ kullaṃ sīse vā āropetvā khandhe vā uccāretvā yena kāmaṃ pakkameyya’nti.
mn22:13.18: api nu so puriso evaṃkārī tasmiṃ kulle kiccakārī assāti?
mn22:13.20: kathaṃkārī ca so bhikkhave puriso tasmiṃ kulle kiccakārī assa?
mn22:13.21: idha bhikkhave tassa purisassa uttiṇṇassa pāraṃ gatassa evamassa:
mn22:13.23: imāhaṃ kullaṃ nissāya hatthehi ca pādehi ca vāyamamāno sotthinā pāraṃ uttiṇṇo.
mn22:13.24: yannūnāhaṃ imaṃ kullaṃ thale vā ussādetvā udake vā opilāpetvā yena kāmaṃ pakkameyyanti.
mn22:13.25: evaṃkārī kho so bhikkhave puriso tasmiṃ kulle kiccakārī assa.
mn22:13.26: evameva kho bhikkhave kullūpamo mayā dhammo desito nittharaṇatthāya no gahaṇatthāya.
mn22:14.1: kullūpamaṃ vo bhikkhave dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānantehi dhammāpi vo pahātabbā, pageva adhammā.
mn22:15.3: idha bhikkhave assutavā puthujjano ariyānaṃ adassāvī ariyadhammassa akovido ariyadhamme avinīto, sappurisānaṃ adassāvī sappurisadhammassa akovido sappurisadhamme avinīto–
mn22:15.4: rūpaṃ ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’ti samanupassati.
mn22:15.5: vedanaṃ ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’ti samanupassati.
mn22:15.6: saññaṃ ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’ti samanupassati.
mn22:15.7: saṅkhāre ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’ti samanupassati.
mn22:15.8: yampidaṃ diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā, tampi ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’ti samanupassati.
mn22:15.10: ‘so loko so attā, so pecca bhavissāmi: nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo, sassatisamaṃ tatheva ṭhassāmī’ti.
mn22:15.11: tampi ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’ti samanupassati.
mn22:16.1: sutavā ca kho bhikkhave ariyasāvako ariyānaṃ dassāvī ariyadhammassa kovido ariyadhamme suvinīto, sappurisānaṃ dassāvī sappurisadhammassa kovido sappurisadhamme suvinīto–
mn22:16.2: rūpaṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti samanupassati.
mn22:16.3: vedanaṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti samanupassati.
mn22:16.4: saññaṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti samanupassati.
mn22:16.5: saṅkhāre ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti samanupassati.
mn22:16.6: yampi taṃ diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā, tampi ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti samanupassati.
mn22:16.8: so loko so attā, so pecca bhavissāmi: nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo, sassatisamaṃ tatheva ṭhassāmī’ti.
mn22:16.9: tampi ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti samanupassati.
mn22:17.1: so evaṃ samanupassanto asati na paritassatīti.
mn22:18.1: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn22:18.2: siyā nu kho bhante bahiddhā asati paritassanāti?
mn22:18.5: ahu vata me, taṃ vata me natthi,
mn22:18.6: siyā vata me, taṃ vatāhaṃ na labhāmīti.
mn22:18.7: so socati kilamati paridevati, urattāḷiṃ kandati, sammohaṃ āpajjati.
mn22:18.8: evaṃ kho bhikkhu bahiddhā asati paritassanā hotī”ti.
mn22:19.1: siyā pana bhante bahiddhā asati aparitassanāti?
mn22:19.4: ‘ahu vata me, taṃ vata me natthi,
mn22:19.5: siyā vata me, taṃ vatāhaṃ na labhāmī’ti.
mn22:19.6: so na socati na kilamati na paridevati, na urattāḷiṃ kandati, na sammohaṃ āpajjati.
mn22:19.7: evaṃ kho bhikkhu bahiddhā asati aparitassanā hotī”ti.
mn22:20.1: siyā nu kho bhante ajjhattaṃ asati paritassanāti?
mn22:20.4: ‘so loko so attā, so pecca bhavissāmi nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo. sassatisamaṃ tatheva ṭhassāmī’ti.
mn22:20.5: so suṇāti tathāgatassa vā tathāgatasāvakassa vā sabbesaṃ diṭṭhiṭṭhānādhiṭṭhānapariyuṭṭhānābhinivesānusayānaṃ samugghātāya sabbasaṅkhārasamathāya sabbūpadhipaṭinissaggāya taṇhakkhayāya virāgāya nirodhāya nibbānāya dhammaṃ desentassa.
mn22:20.7: ‘ucchijjissāmi nāma su, vinassissāmi nāma su, na su nāma bhavissāmī’ti.
mn22:20.8: so socati kilamati paridevati, urattāḷiṃ kandati, sammohaṃ āpajjati.
mn22:20.9: evaṃ kho bhikkhu ajjhattaṃ asati paritassanā hotī”ti.
mn22:21.1: siyā pana bhante ajjhattaṃ asati aparitassanāti?
mn22:21.3: “idha bhikkhu ekaccassa na evaṃ diṭṭhi hoti:
mn22:21.4: ‘so loko so attā, so pecca bhavissāmi nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo. sassatisamaṃ tatheva ṭhassāmī’ti.
mn22:21.5: so suṇāti tathāgatassa vā tathāgatasāvakassa vā sabbesaṃ diṭṭhiṭṭhānādhiṭṭhānapariyuṭṭhānābhinivesānusayānaṃ samugghātāya sabbasaṅkhārasamathāya sabbūpadhipaṭinissaggāya taṇhakkhayāya virāgāya nirodhāya nibbānāya dhammaṃ desentassa.
mn22:21.7: ‘ucchijjissāmi nāma su, vinassissāmi nāma su, na su nāma bhavissāmī’ti.
mn22:21.8: so na socati na kilamati na paridevati, na urattāḷiṃ kandati, na sammohaṃ āpajjati.
mn22:21.9: evaṃ kho bhikkhu ajjhattaṃ asati aparitassanā hoti.”
mn22:22.1: taṃ bhikkhave pariggahaṃ parigaṇheyyātha yvāssa pariggaho nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo, sassatisamaṃ tatheva tiṭṭheyya.
mn22:22.2: passatha no tumhe bhikkhave taṃ pariggahaṃ yvāssa pariggaho nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo, sassatisamaṃ tatheva tiṭṭheyyāti?
mn22:22.5: ahampi kho taṃ bhikkhave pariggahaṃ na samanupassāmi yvāssa pariggaho nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo, sassatisamaṃ tatheva tiṭṭheyya.
mn22:23.1: taṃ bhikkhave attavādūpādānaṃ upādiyetha yaṃsa attavādūpādānaṃ upādiyato na uppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā.
mn22:23.2: passatha no tumhe bhikkhave taṃ attavādūpādānaṃ yaṃsa attavādūpādānaṃ upādiyato na uppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsāti?
mn22:23.5: ahampi kho taṃ bhikkhave attavādūpādānaṃ na samanupassāmi yaṃsa attavādūpādānaṃ upādiyato na uppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā.
mn22:24.1: taṃ bhikkhave diṭṭhinissayaṃ nisseyyātha yaṃsa diṭṭhinissayaṃ nissayato na uppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā.
mn22:24.2: passatha no tumhe bhikkhave taṃ diṭṭhinissayaṃ yaṃsa diṭṭhinissayaṃ nissayato na uppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsāti?
mn22:24.5: ahampi kho taṃ bhikkhave diṭṭhinissayaṃ na samanupassāmi yaṃsa diṭṭhinissayaṃ nissayato na uppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā.
mn22:25.1: attani vā bhikkhave sati ‘attaniyaṃ me’ti assāti?
mn22:25.3: attaniye vā bhikkhave sati ‘attā me’ti assāti?
mn22:25.5: attani ca bhikkhave attaniye ca saccato thetato anupalabbhamāne yampidaṃ diṭṭhiṭṭhānaṃ
mn22:25.6: ‘so loko so attā, so pecca bhavissāmi nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo, sassatisamaṃ tatheva ṭhassāmī’ti,
mn22:25.8: ‘kiṃ hi no siyā bhante, kevalo paripūro bāladhammo’ti.
mn22:26.4: yampanāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti?
mn22:26.6: yampanāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallannu taṃ samanupassituṃ:
mn22:26.10: vedanā niccā vā aniccā vāti? ‘aniccā bhante’. yampanāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti? ‘dukkhaṃ bhante’. yampanāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallannu taṃ samanupassituṃ: ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’ti? ‘no hetaṃ bhante’. taṃ kiṃ maññatha bhikkhave
mn22:26.12: niccā vā aniccā vāti? ‘aniccā bhante’. yampanāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti? ‘dukkhaṃ bhante’. yampanāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallannu taṃ samanupassituṃ: ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’ti? ‘no hetaṃ bhante’. taṃ kiṃ maññatha bhikkhave saṃkhārā niccā vā aniccā vāti? ‘aniccā bhante’. yampanāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti? ‘dukkhaṃ bhante’. yampanāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallannu taṃ samanupassituṃ: ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’ti? ‘no hetaṃ bhante’. taṃ kiṃ maññatha bhikkhave
mn22:26.15: yampanāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti?
mn22:26.17: yampanāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallannu taṃ samanupassituṃ:
mn22:27.1: tasmātiha bhikkhave yaṃ kiñci rūpaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ, ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā, oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā, hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā, yaṃ dūre santike vā, sabbaṃ rūpaṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
mn22:27.5: yaṃ kiñci viññāṇaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ, ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā, oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā, hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā, yaṃ dūre santike vā, sabbaṃ viññāṇaṃ netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attāti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
mn22:28.1: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako rūpasmiṃ nibbindati, vedanāya nibbindati, saññāya nibbindati, saṅkhāresu nibbindati, viññāṇasmiṃ nibbindati,
mn22:29.1: nibbindaṃ virajjati, virāgā vimuccati, vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti.
mn22:29.2: ‘khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānāti.
mn22:30.1: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu ukkhittapaligho itipi, saṅkiṇṇaparikho itipi, abbūḷhesiko itipi, niraggaḷo itipi, ariyo pannaddhajo pannabhāro visaṃyutto itipi.
mn22:31.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno avijjā pahīnā hoti ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
mn22:31.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ukkhittapaligho hoti.
mn22:32.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno ponobhaviko jātisaṃsāro pahīno hoti ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvakato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo.
mn22:32.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu saṃkiṇṇaparikho hoti.
mn22:33.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno taṇhā pahīnā hoti ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
mn22:33.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu abbūḷhesiko hoti.
mn22:34.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno pañcorambhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni pahīnāni honti ucchinnamūlāni tālāvatthukatāni anabhāvakatāni āyatiṃ anuppādadhammāni.
mn22:34.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu niraggaḷo hoti.
mn22:35.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyo pannaddhajo pannabhāro visaṃyutto hoti?
mn22:35.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno asmimāno pahīno hoti ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvaṃkato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo.
mn22:35.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyo pannaddhajo pannabhāro visaṃyutto hoti.
mn22:36.1: evaṃ vimuttacittaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhuṃ saindā devā sabrahmakā sapajāpatikā anvesaṃ nādhigacchanti:
mn22:36.4: diṭṭhevāhaṃ bhikkhave dhamme tathāgataṃ ananuvejjoti vadāmi.
mn22:37.1: evaṃvādiṃ kho maṃ bhikkhave evamakkhāyiṃ eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā asatā tucchā musā abhūtena abbhācikkhanti:
mn22:37.2: venayiko samaṇo gotamo, sato sattassa ucchedaṃ vināsaṃ vibhavaṃ paññāpetīti.
mn22:37.3: yathā vāhaṃ bhikkhave na, yathā vāhaṃ na vadāmi, tathā maṃ te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā asatā tucchā musā abhūtena abbhācikkhanti:
mn22:37.4: venayiko samaṇo gotamo, sato sattassa ucchedaṃ vināsaṃ vibhavaṃ paññāpetīti.
mn22:37.5: pubbe cāhaṃ bhikkhave etarahi ca dukkhañceva paññāpemi dukkhassa ca nirodhaṃ.
mn22:37.6: tatra ce bhikkhave pare tathāgataṃ akkosanti paribhāsanti rosenti, vihesenti, ghaṭṭenti, tatra bhikkhave tathāgatassa na hoti āghāto na appaccayo na cetaso anabhiraddhi.
mn22:38.1: tatra ce bhikkhave pare tathāgataṃ sakkaronti garukaronti mānenti pūjenti, tatra bhikkhave tathāgatassa na hoti ānando somanassaṃ na cetaso ubbilāvitattaṃ.
mn22:38.2: tatra ce bhikkhave pare tathāgataṃ sakkaronti garukaronti mānenti pūjenti, tatra bhikkhave tathāgatassa evaṃ hoti:
mn22:38.3: yaṃ kho idaṃ pubbe pariññātaṃ, tatrime evarūpā kārā karīyantīti.
mn22:39.1: tasmātiha bhikkhave tumhe cepi pare akkoseyyuṃ paribhāseyyuṃ roseyyuṃ viheseyyuṃ, ghaṭṭeyyuṃ. tatra tumhehipi na āghāto na appaccayo na cetaso anabhiraddhi karaṇīyā.
mn22:39.2: tasmātiha bhikkhave tumhe cepi pare sakkareyyuṃ garukareyyuṃ māneyyuṃ pūjeyyuṃ tatra tumhehipi na ānando na somanassaṃ na cetaso ubbilāvitattaṃ karaṇīyaṃ.
mn22:39.3: tasmātiha bhikkhave tumhe cepi pare sakkareyyuṃ garukareyyuṃ māneyyuṃ pūjeyyuṃ tatra tumhepi evamassa:
mn22:39.4: yaṃ kho idaṃ pubbe pariññātaṃ, tatrime evarūpā kārā karīyantīti.
mn22:40.1: tasmātiha bhikkhave yaṃ na tumhākaṃ taṃ pajahatha.
mn22:40.2: taṃ vo pahīnaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
mn22:41.2: rūpaṃ bhikkhave na tumhākaṃ. taṃ pajahatha.
mn22:41.3: taṃ vo pahīnaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
mn22:41.4: vedanā bhikkhave na tumhākaṃ taṃ pajahatha.
mn22:41.5: sā vo pahīnā dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
mn22:41.6: saññā bhikkhave na tumhākaṃ. taṃ pajahatha.
mn22:41.7: sā vo pahīnā dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
mn22:41.8: saṅkhārā bhikkhave na tumhākaṃ. te pajahatha.–
mn22:41.9: te vo pahīnā dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissanti.
mn22:41.10: viññāṇaṃ bhikkhave na tumhākaṃ. taṃ pajahatha.
mn22:41.11: taṃ vo pahīnaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
mn22:41.13: yaṃ imasmiṃ jetavane tiṇakaṭṭhasākhāpalāsaṃ, taṃ jano hareyya vā ḍaheyya vā yathāpaccayaṃ vā kareyya,
mn22:41.15: amhe jano harati vā ḍahati vā yathāpaccayaṃ karotīti?
mn22:41.18: ‘na hi no etaṃ bhante attā attaniyaṃ vā’ti.
mn22:41.19: evameva kho bhikkhave yaṃ na tumhākaṃ taṃ pajahatha.
mn22:41.20: taṃ vo pahīnaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
mn22:41.22: rūpaṃ bhikkhave na tumhākaṃ. taṃ pajahatha.
mn22:41.23: taṃ vo pahīnaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
mn22:41.27: viññāṇaṃ bhikkhave na tumhākaṃ. taṃ pajahatha.
mn22:41.28: taṃ vo pahīnaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
mn22:42.1: evaṃ svākkhāto bhikkhave mayā dhammo uttāno vivaṭo pakāsito chinnapilotiko.
mn22:42.2: evaṃ svākkhāte bhikkhave mayā dhamme uttāne vivaṭe pakāsite chinnapilotike, ye te bhikkhū arahanto khīṇāsavā vusitavanto katakaraṇīyā ohitabhārā anuppattasadatthā parikkhīṇabhavasaññojanā sammadaññā vimuttā, vaṭṭaṃ tesaṃ natthi paññāpanāya.
mn22:43.1: evaṃ svākkhāto bhikkhave mayā dhammo uttāno vivaṭo pakāsito chinnapilotiko.
mn22:43.2: evaṃ svākkhāte bhikkhave mayā dhamme uttāne vivaṭe pakāsite chinnapilotike, yesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pañcorambhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni pahīnāni, sabbe te opapātikā, tattha parinibbāyino anāvattidhammā tasmā lokā.
mn22:44.1: evaṃ svākkhāto bhikkhave mayā dhammo uttāno vivaṭo pakāsito chinnapilotiko.

mn22:45.1: evaṃ svākkhāto bhikkhave mayā dhammo uttāno vivaṭo pakāsito chinnapilotiko.
